in_hebrew.name: Maurie
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Maurie הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek name Maurus, which means 'Maur' or 'dark-skinned', and 'born of the sea'. This name has been popular in Western cultures, particularly among Christians, due to its biblical connections and symbolism of new beginnings and transformation.
